definition: topK = share of the forecast's top K that finished in the day's final daily top K (all ranked launches of the day), x100; days are PT dates

sources.live: 00:05 forecast written within 30 min of 00:05 PT; P / R points within 90 min of their data cut
sources.late: honest data cut but written later than that (not a live call)
sources.shadow: shadow lines written after 01:00 PT from inputs stamped <= 00:05 (by design; not a live call)
sources.replay: re-run afterwards with only data up to the point time
sources.replay_in_sample: replay whose recipe weights were chosen on the same days (pred_rank_best on Nov 2-10)

per_pick: p1/p2/p3_top3 = our #1/#2/#3 pick finished in the final top 3; exact1 = our #1 was the winner
time_shown: written_at (when the forecast file was written), not the data cut

clean_thread_coef.what: day-clustered coefficient of z(th_n_pre) controlling for z(clean 00:05 score), pooled OLS of z(-log final rank), z within day
